description: Maisons du vélo Île-de-France Mobilités et Points de location Véligo Location is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Description: Ce jeu de données liste les différents types de points de service et d’accueil vélo proposés par Île-de-France Mobilités: les Maisons du vélo fixes et mobiles et les points de location Véligo Location. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Vélos & Nouvelles mobilités. Its keywords are Maison du Vélo, Services vélo, Conseils, Essais, Location, Réparation. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
